notes.title: The Lone Sword Demo is available for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sVsLG5aeW1Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey Everyone! We are incredibly excited to announce that The Lone Sword Demo is available for Steam Next Fest. As the game is still in development, we decided to share the beginning with the first few levels to give you a glimpse of what we are creating. Please let us know what you think and share your feedback!

Get the Demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444510/The_Lone_Sword_Demo/]here[/url]!

Looking forward to your thoughts!

[img]https://i0.wp.com/subpixels.pl/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/sword-steam-fest-header.png?resize=1000%2C563&ssl=1[/img]
